en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with two‑storey houses with dormer roofs and shuttered windows. People walk and children play in the street while a man rides a bicycle; a horse‑drawn cart is further in the distance. Painted signs in German script appear on the facades, including an inn or guesthouse on the left. At the far end of the street, an industrial complex with a tall chimney dominates the background.
